entries.note: BFE's own row, the place first: the flight's arrival in the destination country, its first row on a parcel to Argentina. The adapter moves the place into the location.
BFE's own row, the place first: on the way within the destination country, before the clearance row.
BFE's own row, the place first, an hour after the transport to the next facility and an hour before the hand-over to the last mile, at the same place: the clearance done, the parcel not held.

entries.wording: …, Turned over to last mile facility
entries.note: BFE's own row, the place first: handed to the delivering depot, before that depot's own scans.
BFE's own row in Argentina, the country first: the parcel received there, a day after the hand-over to the last mile depot.
The same receipt in Argentina in other words, the country first as its code, the day after the hand-over to the last mile depot.
BFE's own row in Argentina, the country first: on its way, a day after the receipt and before the transport row.
BFE's own row in Argentina, the country first: loaded for the next leg, at the minute of the receipt and again half an hour later.
BFE's own row in Argentina, the country first: on the move between its loading rows.
BFE's own row in Argentina, the country first: on its way, a day after its transport row.
BFE's own row in Argentina, the country first: the delivery round, hours after the transport row.
BFE's own row in Argentina, the country first: the delivery round in the words of the Uruguayan last mile's row. The adapter moves the country into the location.
BFE's own row, the place first as on the round before it: the delivery, hours after the round.
BFE's own row in Argentina, the country first: the round could not deliver, and the row after it gives the reason.
The reason a minute after the failed delivery: the business was closed. The parcel goes on in transit.

entries.wording: Tu paquete fue recibido por en: …
entries.note: Your parcel was received at …: the first scan of the Uruguayan last mile, after BFE's hand-over to it.

entries.wording: Tu paquete está en viaje a …
entries.note: Your parcel is on its way to …: the place is where it goes, not where it is.

entries.wording: En espera para salir a reparto en …
entries.note: Waiting to go out for delivery at …: at the delivering office, hours before the round starts.
Your parcel is at …, written at the same minute as the wait for the round, before it.
Delivery in progress: the round, before the delivery.
Delivered; BFE's own status for the parcel says Delivered beside it.
